hooks.rewakeMessage: implement-plan completed successfully. Run the kmp-reviewer agent now to review the current diff.
hooks.command: PLAN='.claude/plan.md'; HASH_FILE='.claude/.last-reviewed-plan-hash'; grep -q '\*\*Status:\*\* Implemented' "$PLAN" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; CURRENT=$(md5 -q "$PLAN"); [ "$(cat "$HASH_FILE" 2>/dev/null)" = "$CURRENT" ] && exit 0; echo "$CURRENT" > "$HASH_FILE" && exit 2
